Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

 

Qualifications to succeed in this project:

 

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.
  • Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance
  Qualification path

How to get started:

  • Complete your contributor profile and application

  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Back-End

Front-End

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.

What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently

  • Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects

  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
  • Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos


Working at Metics Media

At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. Role Overview:

  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

What we’re looking for

  • Strong proficiency in React, Next.js, TypeScript/JavaScript.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS for production workloads.

  • Solid understanding of web security best practices (OWASP, secure storage, encryption in transit/at rest, secrets management).

  • Experience building systems in or adjacent to healthcare, education, or compliance-heavy environments is a plus.

  • Excellent async communication, code ownership, and ability to work with a small, senior-led team.

  • Comfort working from a clear product brief and also proposing improvements proactively.

  • Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and observability tools.

Take-home assignment (Step 1 of the process)

Please complete a take-home assignment. You are allowed to use LLMs to write code. To ensure that your work will not be used at Fluence, we’ve made it unrelated to healthcare:

Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows

A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n.

Stack

  • Next.js (App Router)

  • Clerk for authentication

  • Convex for data + backend logic

  • n8n (self-hosted via Docker or n8n Cloud) for workflow automation

  • TypeScript

Requirements

Public page

  • The fictional company name is LendLoop.

  • Short tagline, e.g. “Borrow what you need. Lend what you don’t.”

  • Show:

  • A “Sign in to lend or borrow” button wired to Clerk.

Authenticated experience

  • Only signed-in users can:

  • List a tool with:

  • name

  • category (power tools, garden, kitchen, camping, etc.)

  • condition

  • short description

  • Request to borrow a tool for a date range.

  • Approve or decline requests on their own tools.

  • Mark a loan as returned.

  • Show:

  • All tools with availability status, filterable by category.

  • “My listings”, “My requests”, and “Incoming requests” views.

  • Nice, minimal layout.

Roles & rules

  • admin:

  • user:

    • Can create, edit, and delete only their own listings, and act only on requests involving their own tools or their own borrowing.

  • Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI.

As an Associate Security Engineer, you will help to drive our vulnerability management program while contributing across multiple security domains in a collaborative, globally distributed environment. You can find more information about our security program at https://www.kayak.com/security.

This role is required to work from our Berlin, Germany office 3 days per week.

In this role, you will:

  • Contribute to security automation and orchestration workflows that reduce manual effort and improve response times.

  • Document processes, runbooks, and findings to support team knowledge sharing and continuity.

  • Participate in access reviews and support identity and access management processes in line with established policies.

  • Stay current with the evolving threat landscape and contribute ideas for improving the team's detection and response capabilities.

  • A solid understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals — including networking, operating systems (Linux, macOS, or Windows), and cloud environments — gained through any combination of formal education, self-study, bootcamps, or professional experience.

  • Hands-on experience in at least one security domain, such as vulnerability management, incident response, application security, endpoint security, or identity and access management.

  • Experience working with security tooling (e.g., vulnerability scanners, endpoint detection and response platforms, SIEM systems, or similar); familiarity with specific tools is a plus, but willingness to learn our stack matters more than exact tool experience.

At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

CesiumAstro is expanding its global footprint with the establishment of a new office in Munich, Germany. We are looking to add a Senior Manager of Talent Acquisition to the team who will play a critical leadership role in building and supporting this next phase of CesiumAstro’s growth in Europe.

In this position, you will lead talent acquisition efforts for CesiumAstro’s Munich office, developing and executing the recruiting strategy required to build the organization from the ground up. The Senior Manager will partner closely with leadership, human resources, and functional leaders to translate business and workforce plans into an effective hiring strategy for Germany and the broader European talent market.


JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Partner with U.S. based Talent Acquisition and Human Resources leadership to align European hiring activities, processes, and operating standards with CesiumAstro’s broader talent strategy.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing recruiting team to support rapid growth in Munich and broader European hiring needs.
  • Lead full-cycle recruiting for critical positions, including specialized engineering, technical, operations, and business roles.
  • Develop targeted sourcing strategies and talent pipelines across Europe for highly specialized professionals in aerospace, satellite communications, RF systems, electronics, embedded systems, hardware, software, and related disciplines.
  • Partner with executives, hiring managers, and technical leaders to define position requirements, develop candidate profiles, establish interview strategies, and drive hiring decisions.
  • Establish and scale the recruiting infrastructure, resources, and capabilities necessary as hiring demand grows.
  • Build CesiumAstro’s employer presence within the German and European aerospace and advanced technology markets through relationships with universities, technical institutions, professional organizations, industry networks, and talent communities.
  • Deliver a high-quality candidate experience that reflects CesiumAstro’s culture, mission, technical ambition, and growth trajectory.

    • JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Communications, Psychology, or a related field with a minimum of 9 years of related experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruiting, Human Resources, workforce planning, or a related discipline.
  • 2–5 years of leadership or management experience leading Talent Acquisition professionals, recruiting teams, or significant recruiting initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing recruiting strategies in a high-growth or rapidly scaling organization.
  • Significant experience recruiting specialized engineering and technical talent.
  • Strong understanding of the German talent market and demonstrated ability to recruit across Germany and, where appropriate, the broader European market.
  • Knowledge of applicable German and European recruiting, employment, candidate data privacy, and recordkeeping requirements.
  • Expertise in full-cycle recruiting, sourcing strategy, talent pipeline development, candidate assessment, workforce planning, and talent acquisition program management.
  • Advanced analytical judgment in interpreting recruiting metrics, pipeline health, source effectiveness, hiring forecasts, and workforce trends.
  • Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to translate organizational objectives and workforce requirements into actionable recruiting strategies.
  •  Ability to operate effectively in a startup environment where strategy development and hands-on execution are equally important.
  • Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) such as Greenhouse, Lever, Workday Recruiting, iCIMS, or similar platforms.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to partner effectively with executives, technical leaders, hiring managers, candidates, and colleagues across multiple locations and time zones.
  • Professional proficiency in English required; German language proficiency is strongly preferred.

    • PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
  • Experience within space, aerospace, defense, satellite, RF, electronics, telecommunications, or another advanced technology environment.
  • Experience building a new office, business unit, geographic market, or technical organization.

Are you a seasoned construction planner that is a bit tired of the standard old-fashioned wayof doing things in the construction industry?
Do you get deep satisfaction from making things run more effi ciently using a good dose ofcommon sense and maybe a bit of technology?
Have you always cared about the importance of proper planning and the connection betweenthe schedule and the real day-to-day delivery of the job?
Have you ever wanted to work a bit more fl exibly but still be hands-on in construction andimproving the industry?
Sounds like a dream. Well, it isn’t, it is actually quite real!
Read on! ____________________________________________________________ We are Laminar Projects!   If you’ve already heard about us, you’re probably reading this because you’re tired of the typical, chaotic ways of doing things in construction. But in case you haven’t, we’re a high-end project management consultancy and tech developer with a focus on upgrading the way construction projects are delivered.   Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Check out our short film about it.) We bring transparency and control to projects through a pragmatic mix of the latest tech, our own processes, and a big dose of common sense. We then take our deep understanding of these projects and we invest heavily into developing the digital solutions that anyone can use to deliver their projects better. (Check out Shape, our construction management tech, to see what we’re doing.)   The core of all this is our true secret sauce: our people. We only recruit the very best, both in capability and personality. We’re deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that’s optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People who join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. (Read more about our vision and missions.)   This approach has allowed us to grow from just two people in 2017 to over 220 today. We have a stable, repeat client base across infrastructure and complex building projects in the UK and internationally, and we’re still growing fast. Joining us isn’t just some “job”. It’s a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. There are many diverse and interesting challenges available. It’s up to you to guide yourself into whichever areas you’re most interested – we’ll enable it.    (Get to know us better by watching a few more of our videos.)   Core values for a good life   A life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships and challenging yourself to create a positive impact, so our values reflect the four levels of relationships that each of us has:   - Grow yourself – your relationship with yourself  - Care about people – your relationship with others around you  - Execute to greatness – your relationship with your team  - Build civilisation – your relationship with humanity and the world    We enshrined our values in our vision:   We exist so that everyone in our team can flourish in a high-impact community that:   - Connects us with meaningful relationships  - Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans  - Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures    By first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world.   And enable the achievement of our vision through our two missions:   - To fully digitalise the construction of human civilisation  - To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society ____________________________________________________________ The Role    Purpose of the role   You will be enhancing the delivery of the most complex and interesting projects in the world through the power of project planning. You will be a senior leader in our team pushing the discipline to new heights not only within Laminar but within the industry in general.   Your Team   This role is part of our Project Management Consultancy which focuses on:
- Understanding what the real problems of projects are
- Implementing the best solutions to those problems
- Developing scalable best practices, tools and technology
  More specifically you will be part of our Project Planning Discipline Team who are industry leaders in the planning of complex construction projects. Your initial leader will be one of our planning discipline directors.   Your top 3 objectives
1. To make construction projects deliver to near perfection
2. To create scalable and repeatable solutions to common problems
3. To develop yourself and everyone around you
Your top 5 responsibilities
1. Own the plan: Own the project plan for one or more projects and ensure that the project isworking to it eff ectively. Ensure delays are mitigated and managed commercially.
2. Own the outcome: You may not be the project manager ultimately responsible for the resultsbut you are sure as heck responsible for putting in your best eff ort to ensure the project’sunderstanding and focus on the plan no matter how stubborn they are!
3. Report and inform: Provide simple actionable reports to stakeholders at all levels that helpthem deliver their part of the project more effi ciently and eff ectively.
4. Make scalable solutions: Develop scalable and repeatable best practices and tools incollaboration with the team so that long-term impact is achieved.
5. Develop everyone: Maximise the development of your team personally and professionallyand educate our clients to improve as well.   Must-Have (The fundamentals)
- Mastery: Solid construction project planning capability in all aspects that take into accountstrategic objectives and the broad context you are operating in
- Communication: The charisma, infl uence and presence to get construction people to do newthings and take the best approach
- Leadership: A proven leader/coach/developer of teams
- Impact: A track record of implementing scalable and repeatable solutions in projects that hada signifi cant positive impact   Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true:
- You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge
- You like to be the smartest person in the room
- You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
- You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team ____________________________________________________________ Frequently Asked Questions    What kinds of projects would I be working on? It’s common for people to be exposed to several projects in their first year with us. You’ll work on some of the most complex and interesting environments in the world. We’ve delivered over 100 data centres internationally, many of them fast-tracked and multi-package. Our teams have supported flagship infrastructure programmes like HS2 through integrated planning and digital delivery, contributed to over $30bn in power generation and transmission projects, and played a key role in the development of high-containment labs and R&D campuses for some of the world’s most advanced industrial and life sciences clients. You might find yourself working in sectors such as data centres, infrastructure (including defense, rail, and highways), high tech (such as advanced manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and semiconductors), or complex building projects. These aren’t hands-off assignments. They’re dynamic, hands-on environments designed for people who want to be challenged. We bring back the lessons from every project to help our team grow and deliver the highest levels of value. (Check out our case stories.)    Who are our clients? Major owners/operators and main contractors with project values between £1m and £1bn+ globally.    Where would I be working? One week you might be working from home. The next, you might travel to the site to meet the construction teams and help organise them. Maybe you’ll pop into our London office for a workshop or a beer. Maybe you’ll fly out to exotic (and sometimes not!) locations in Europe or the Middle East to visit clients. It really depends on what you want to get involved in and what fits with your life.    How does what I do connect with the long-term impact on the construction industry?  You’re tasked with understanding and solving common problems. We don’t want to reinvent the wheel every time, so you’ll be responsible for documenting new solutions and evolving ones we’ve developed. This goes into our knowledge repository, which we’re going to open source to the industry.    The knowledge you capture will be used by us to build new products. You’ll constantly test those products in the field, so we can rapidly iterate and improve them for anyone in the industry to use.  ____________________________________________________________ Benefits   The standard stuff:    - Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. jobs.description_html:
Über uns

Probantica ist ein Anbieter für Qualitätstests aus Köln. Wir prüfen im Auftrag von Unternehmen, ob digitale Produkte und Abläufe vor Ort im Alltag funktionieren. Die Tests machen bei uns angestellte Qualitätsmanager:innen – Menschen mit Vertrag, fester Ansprechperson und klaren Vorgaben.

Worum es geht

Unternehmen müssen wissen, ob ihre Apps, Websites und Filialen im Alltag wirklich funktionieren. Als Kunde gehst du die angebotenen Abläufe durch: App öffnen, Konto anlegen, Formular ausfüllen, Bestellung abschließen, in eine Filiale gehen. Du testest den Prozess von Anfang bis Ende, dokumentierst jeden Schritt mit Uhrzeit und Screenshot und markierst die Stellen, an denen etwas hakt oder unklar bleibt.

Vor jedem Auftrag bekommst du eine Anleitung mit Schritten, Zeitrahmen und den Fragen, die am Ende beantwortet sein müssen. Kein Rätselraten, kein Vertrieb, keine Kaltakquise. Getestet wird auf deinem eigenen Gerät, in deiner Nähe.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Digitale Produkte testen: App, Website oder Online-Prozess einmal vollständig durchlaufen – von der Anmeldung bis zum Abschluss.
  • Abläufe vor Ort prüfen: in Filialen, Shops oder Servicestellen, mit Blick auf Wartezeit, Beratung und Abwicklung.
  • Auffälligkeiten festhalten: Screenshot machen, Uhrzeit notieren, in zwei bis fünf Sätzen beschreiben, was passiert ist.
  • Bericht einreichen: die vorgegebenen Fragen beantworten, Dauer je Schritt angeben, Ergebnis knapp zusammenfassen.
  • Nachfragen beantworten: wenn das Team zu einem Befund etwas wissen möchte, kurz und sachlich antworten.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du bist mindestens 18 Jahre alt.
  • Du hast ein Smartphone oder einen Laptop mit Internetzugang – Geräte für App- und Website-Tests stellst du selbst.
  • Du drückst dich in klaren, verständlichen Sätzen aus und arbeitest sorgfältig.
  • Du hältst Termine ein und meldest dich, wenn etwas nicht klappt.

Das brauchst du nicht

  • Kein Studium, keine Ausbildung in einem bestimmten Bereich, kein Führerschein.
  • Keine eigene Firma, keine Anmeldung beim Finanzamt.
  • Keine Kosten – weder für die Bewerbung noch für die Ausrüstung.

Vergütung pro Auftrag

Feste Pauschale je abgeschlossenem Auftrag, gestaffelt nach Umfang. Ausgezahlt wird monatlich, sobald der Bericht abgenommen ist – unabhängig davon, wie lange du gebraucht hast.

Richtwerte. Das konkrete Honorar steht in jedem Auftrag, bevor du ihn annimmst. Die Pauschale ist so bemessen, dass der gesetzliche Mindestlohn für die aufgewendete Zeit nicht unterschritten wird.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Faire Pauschale – bis zu 49 € pro Auftrag, monatlich ausgezahlt, ohne Provision und ohne Abzug.
  • Anstellung statt anonymer Crowd – Arbeitsvertrag und feste Ansprechperson statt Bewertungsplattform.
  • Minijob oder Teilzeit – Minijob bis zur Geringfügigkeitsgrenze (2026: 603 € monatlich), Teilzeit bis 20 Stunden pro Woche.
  • Flexible Einteilung – du sagst, wann du Zeit hast; keine festen Schichten.
  • Klare Vorgaben – jede Aufgabe mit Anleitung, Zeitrahmen und den Fragen für den Bericht.
  • Persönliche Begleitung – im Panel erreichst du deinen Supervisor direkt, ohne Ticket-System.
  • Kurzer Weg – Bewerbung in etwa zehn Minuten, Rückmeldung meist innerhalb von zwei Werktagen.

So läuft die Bewerbung

  1. Zehn Fragen beantworten (etwa 5 Minuten) – online, ohne Anmeldung, ohne Lebenslauf.
  2. Persönliche Daten eintragen – Name, Anschrift, Geburtsdatum, Kontaktdaten.
  3. Rückmeldung per E-Mail – bei einer Zusage kommen die Zugangsdaten für dein Panel mit.
  4. Arbeitsvertrag digital unterschreiben – Minijob oder Teilzeit.
  5. Onboarding im Panel – kurze Einführung, danach die ersten Aufträge.

Gut zu wissen

  • Keine Provision: bezahlt wird der abgeschlossene Auftrag, nicht die Anzahl gefundener Fehler.
  • Keine Vorkasse, keine Kaution, kein Verkauf an Freunde oder Familie.
  • Du bestimmst, wie viele Aufträge du übernimmst – es gibt keine Mindestanzahl.
  • Alle Geschlechter willkommen. Schwerbehinderte Bewerber:innen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

Zone & Company Software Consulting LLC (“Zone”) is the ERP-native AI platform for financial operations, purpose-built for organizations running on Oracle NetSuite. We are redefining how finance teams operate by delivering an AI-powered system that automates, connects, and scales financial workflows directly within the ERP.

Our platform spans the full financial lifecycle, including Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Treasury, Payroll Management, and Record-to-Report, eliminating manual processes and unlocking real-time financial intelligence.

By embedding intelligence directly into NetSuite, Zone helps finance teams move beyond reactive work to proactive, strategic impact. Learn more at www.zoneandco.com or follow us on LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/zoneandco.

About the role

Zone & Co. is looking for a high-velocity Account Executive to sell finance automation solutions to the Office of the CFO. We move fast, set ambitious goals, and expect our team to deliver. Our targets are designed to be achievable, and we're looking for disciplined, driven sellers who know how to manage a pipeline, maintain deal momentum, and consistently convert opportunities into closed business.

You'll own pipeline generation through strategic outbound prospecting, complemented by additional opportunities from our partner ecosystem and marketing team.

If you thrive in a fast-paced sales environment, are comfortable navigating short sales cycles, bring rigor to your MEDDPICC process, and enjoy building relationships face-to-face with partners and customers, this could be the opportunity for you. You'll also have the chance to develop deep expertise across a broad and growing product portfolio in a dynamic, expanding market.

What you'll do:

  • Own a net new number. Win new logos across a defined EMEA territory against an annual ARR target, measured monthly and quarterly.
  • Build your own pipeline. Outbound is part of the job, every week: calls, sequences, LinkedIn, and your own network. Partner and marketing leads are a bonus, not the plan.
  • Get out there. Travel to partner offices, industry events, and customer meetings. Face time with partners and clients is key.
  • Work the partner ecosystem. Build trusted relationships with our implementation and referral partners so they bring you in early and back you to close.
  • Run a high-velocity motion. Manage 30 + active opportunities at once and close 10–15 deals a month, from first call through pricing, paper process and signature.
  • Sell with discipline. Use MEDDPICC on every deal: find the pain, the metrics and the economic buyer, build a champion, and run a clear close plan with a next step every time.
  • Sell the whole journey. We are positioning the complete end-to-end story. We want to connect the customer pain with how to solve finance challenges, and turn that vision into bigger, multi-product wins.
  • Partner with Solution Consulting. Bring in SCs at the right moment for sharp, tailored demos on larger deals.
  • Forecast accurately. Keep Salesforce clean and call your number with confidence every week.

What success looks like:

  • You consistently hit, and regularly beat, your monthly and quarterly ARR targets.
  • Your pipeline is a good mix of self-sourced and partner-sourced from relationships you've built.
  • Partners know you by name and bring you into their deals early.
  • Your deals are MEDDPICC-complete, your forecast is reliable, and your average deal size grows as you sell more of the platform.

What you'll bring:

  • 5+ years closing net new SaaS business, with a track record of hitting and overachieving ARR targets in a fast-paced, transactional or mid-market motion.
  • A real outbound habit: you prospect daily and you're proud of the pipeline you create yourself.

  • A diligent, organised approach: you manage a busy pipeline without dropping the detail.

  • Happy on the road: comfortable travelling to partner sites, events and client meetings across the UK and EMEA.
  • Confident with Salesforce, Gong and modern sales tools. As well as AI tools such as Clay and Claude.

Benefits

At Zone, we provide the platform; you provide the grit. We operate as a high-velocity, fully remote, global team where autonomy isn't just a perk, it’s the standard. We’re looking for self-driven professionals eager to navigate the complexities of a unique SaaS environment and take full command of their professional evolution.

We ditch micro-management for high-trust flexibility, ensuring you have the space to innovate and scale. Our benefits are built to fuel this lifestyle, supporting your life beyond the screen so you can focus on making a global impact. Explore our offerings at https://www.zoneandco.com/careers

What You Will Do (Responsibilities):

We are a small US firm that writes federal funding proposals for technology companies, for a fixed fee. We are looking for one US-based closer for booked calls. The role starts with a paid two-week trial.

The work

  • Our sales are written-first. A prospect replies to our email, receives a free one-page written plan, and picks a call time in writing. You take those booked calls, return calls from prospects who phoned us, and rebook missed calls. No cold dialing and no lists.
  • On each call you qualify, present our written fixed-fee offer (mid four figures to low five figures), confirm who signs, and ask for the decision. We send every agreement and payment link.
  • You send a short written report after each call, the same day.
  • Calls are in US business hours (Eastern Time). The work is remote.

Who fits

  • You are based in the United States.
  • You have personally closed B2B service sales of US$5,000 or more with business owners or technical founders, on the phone.
  • Experience selling to companies that pursue federal, SBIR or defense work is a strong plus.
  • You are comfortable following a written call guide and firm rules: no promises about outcomes and no discounts.
  • You do not currently write or sell federal proposal, white paper, SBIR or capture services for anyone else.

How we screen and what we pay

  1. Your written answers to the three questions below.
  2. Finalists record a 3 to 5 minute drill on a short script we send. The drill is paid: US$40.
  3. Every drill is scored on the same written scorecard.
  4. The strongest candidates are offered a paid two-week trial: US$45 an hour, up to 10 hours a week, plus 15% of the fees we actually collect on deals you close. The exact terms are in a written agreement you see before you start.
  5. The role after the trial depends on results. We do not promise a drill, a trial, a hire, or any number of hours, calls, deals or earnings. Call volume is modest today.

Part-time to start; the best performer moves to more hours as booked calls grow.

  1. Describe one B2B service sale of US$5,000 or more that you personally closed: what the service was, the price, and who signed.

Headquarters: Ireland (Remote)

Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world's most important workflows. 

Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson.

Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations.

As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design. 

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

We're looking for a sales compensation leader to own how we pay our go-to-market organisation, and how that changes as our commercial model changes. You will run the engine that pays roughly 350 GTM people accurately and on time, own the design of the plans, quotas and incentives behind it, and lead a small team of analysts.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will manage and coach a small team, and you will also be in the model, in CaptivateIQ, and in the plan documents yourself.

What you'll do

Run the compensation engine

  • Own the monthly and quarterly compensation cycle end to end: crediting, calculation, review, approval and payout, delivered accurately and on time
  • Own CaptivateIQ as our system of record for incentive compensation, including plan build, rule logic, testing and release
  • Own crediting and comp data integrity across Salesforce and downstream systems, and work with Systems and Deal Desk to fix problems at source rather than in spreadsheets
  • Oversee inquiry management ensuring clear SLAs and report on trends to improve overall processes
  • Document and keep policies and process up to date for stakeholders and your team

Design the plans, quotas and incentives

  • Own annual plan design in partnership with your Senior compensation analyst, GTM leadership, FP&A and People for all commissioned roles
  • Collaborate with Revops business partners on the quota setting process for each function to ensure it aligns with broader compensation strategy and benchmarks
  • Model attainment distribution, benchmarks and support finance in ad-hoc cost reporting
  • Own and build SPIFFs and non-cash incentive programmes, including President's Club,
  • Own plan communication and enablement, so reps and managers understand what they are paid for and can self-serve where needed

Evolve the compensation strategy as we grow

  • Build the compensation approach for an evolving pricing model and mulit-product business in partnership with the Head of Revenue Operations and VP of Finance
  • Represent compensation requirements during larger CPQ and CRM enhancements or changes
  • Enhance our approach based compensation reporting: attainment by role and segment, payout curves, quota coverage and programme effectiveness

Lead and grow the team

  • Manage, coach and develop a small team of compensation analysts, and set the standard and what good looks like
  • Prioritise the team's work, capacity and quarterly OKRs to ensure a balance of reactiveness and impactful projects
  • Stay hands-on. This is a doing and leading role, not a management-only role

What you'll bring

Required experience

  • 6+ years in sales compensation, revenue operations, sales finance or a closely related field, with experience managing or formally mentoring analysts
  • 2-3 years direct management experience
  • Proven ownership of a full incentive compensation cycle for a distributed GTM team, including crediting, calculation, payout and dispute resolution
  • Hands-on administration of an ICM platform, ideally CaptivateIQ, including building and testing plan logic yourself
  • Demonstrated plan design experience: pay mix, leverage, accelerators and quota setting, with the modelling to back the recommendation
  • Strong Salesforce data fluency, and the ability to translate commercial requirements into system and crediting logic
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets modelling, including capacity, attainment and cost of sale models
  • Excellent stakeholder management, with the credibility to hold a position with Sales leaders and the judgement to know when to flex
  • You can communicate simply, clearly, and directly, especially with senior leaders, and your written work is polished enough to go straight to an executive audience

Bonus points

  • Experience with consumption, usage-based or hybrid pricing models and their compensation implications
  • Experience through a CPQ or quote-to-cash migration, ideally Salesforce CPQ or Dealhub
  • Experience in cybersecurity, IT or AI markets
  • Familiarity with ASC 606 commission capitalisation and audit requirements
  • Experience compensating post-sales and partner roles, not just AEs
